title: Pick up a task
concept: Issues; one branch per task; push the branch

story.speaker: Priya
story.text: I wrote down what still needs doing as **issues** on the website.

story.speaker: Priya
story.text: An issue is just a note: a title, a description, and who is doing it.

story.speaker: Priya
story.text: Issue #1 is yours. Open the Issues tab and read it.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Leave a comment so we know you started. That is normal team manners.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Then make a branch just for this task. One task, one branch.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Push the branch with `-u` so it exists on the website too.

hub.title: Add a food stalls page
hub.body:
Visitors keep asking what food will be there.

Please add food.html listing the stalls. Mention that the samosa stall is vegetarian.

items.text: Comment on issue #1 to say you started
Make a branch for this task
Commit food.html mentioning the vegetarian samosa stall
Push the branch to the website

hints: Four things: comment on the issue, branch, commit, push the branch.
Use the comment box on the issue page. Then `git switch -c food-stalls`, commit food.html, and `git push -u origin food-stalls`.

Comment on issue #1 in the website panel. Then `git switch -c food-stalls`, write food.html with the word samosa, `git add food.html`, `git commit -m "Add food stalls page"`, `git push -u origin food-stalls`.
recap: An issue records a task. Make one branch per task, then push that branch so teammates can see it.

cheatSheet.summary: Send a new branch to the website and link it

solution.run:
echo "

Food stalls

The samosa stall is vegetarian.
